method: Read-only production SQLite queries and in-memory gzip compression of one existing FITS per camera; no media, configuration or service changes.
limits: One source sample per camera; scene noise, exposure and day/night change compression ratios.
Projection assumes constant 15-second cadence; excludes outputs, thumbnails, database and filesystem overhead.
Compression timing is one run, not a sustained performance or capture-stability test.
Existing FITS may be calibrated; a future authoritative source must preserve original samples before calibration.
All-exposure source retention is not enabled. Pending choice between short retention and additional storage.
Current JPEG-dependent consumers must be migrated before source-only archival can safely replace them.
